Title: Hunger of Marduk and additional Strike

Messages.Author: frenteria
Messages.Body:
Does the vampire using Hunger of Marduk have the option to use the steal at any time during the round ? Specifically, if an additional strike is played, may the vampire elect to use the steal again? Or is the steal only useable once during the round?

Thanks!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> frenteria wrote:
> Does the vampire using Hunger of Marduk have the option to use the steal at any time during the round ? Specifically, if an additional strike is played, may the vampire elect to use the steal again? Or is the steal only useable once during the round?
>
> Thanks!
>
The strike provided by Hunger of Marduk can be chosen and used more than once during the round.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body: Not disagreeing with you Ankha, I am just curious why the template has been shortened from Improvised Tactics "At long range, each round, this minion may strike for 2R damage each strike." As a native English speaker I typically did not considered this a redundancy, but a clarification to remove ambiguity. Is this a recent shift in rule streamlining?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Azel wrote:
> Not disagreeing with you Ankha, I am just curious why the template has been shortened from Improvised Tactics "At long range, each round, this minion may strike for 2R damage each strike." As a native English speaker I typically did not considered this a redundancy, but a clarification to remove ambiguity. Is this a recent shift in rule streamlining?
>
This pattern is no longer in use since Heirs to the Blood where it was reworded as "strike: X".
If no limitation is provided, you can use the strike whenever you have to choose the strike; otherwise, the limitation is provided ("once each round, this vampire can strike: X")
